3291378705.title: MAJOR ORDER
3291378705.brief: Acquire Automaton samples and kill Cyborgs to aid the development of enhanced digital interrogation techniques.

phases.title: CONTAINMENT
phases.intro: Hordes of Voteless abominations have been detected on planets close to the Void. They have swarmed across SANGIS and BASQUINE VIII, formerly untouched preserves. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate those planets from the Voteless hordes. High Command has authorized the use of new FRV models: INCINERATOR FRV on SANGIS and SUPPLY FRV on BASQUINE VIII. The FRV model associated with the first liberated planet will go into full-scale production.

phases.title: MATERIAL ACQUISITION
phases.intro: Ministry of Science xenobiologists have made a discovery: captured Voteless from BASQUINE VIII are altered at a cellular level. Ministry of Science experts believe this could present a key opportunity to learn more about the Void. To this end, a large-scale tissue processing facility will be constructed. Deploy to Automaton-held BLISTICA to secure the enemy's bio-processors. Additionally, secure 15,000,000 samples from ALARAPH, currently overrun by Voteless.

phases.title: REPATRIATION
phases.intro: The Ministry of Science has commenced construction of a Voteless Processing Plant on ALARAPH. This highly advanced facility will humanely process inert Voteless tissue, preparing it for scientific study in order to advance our understanding of the Void. Hold ALARAPH until the facility is complete. Additionally, prepare 25,000,000 Voteless specimens for study, by rendering them inert.

phases.title: DEPLOYMENT
phases.intro:
Super Earth is constructing a new wall of TCS+ arrays. High Command assures citizens that the new and improved "Termicide 2.0" dispersed by TCS+ Towers is 110% safe, righteously liquefying Terminids, while promoting pine-scented health benefits to colonists within the efficacy radius.

In an imprudent bid to escape their fate, the Terminids have launched a massive wave of attacks to halt construction.

Helldivers must defend against 5 Terminid attacks to secure the sites. Wherever Helldivers successfully hold the line is where the unshakeable borders of Liberty will be drawn.

phases.title: PROCUREMENT
phases.intro: Construction of the new TCS+ wall is exceeding all projections. To maintain this breathless, record-setting pace, the Ministry of Expansion requires an immediate influx of gas and mineral resources. The Helldivers are ordered to secure these resources by liberating MOX from the Automatons and GENESIS PRIME from the Illuminate. Simultaneously, Helldivers must hold BRILLIANCE, where active construction of planetary TCS+ arrays is taking place. Procure the necessary resources by any means necessary, so the new unbreakable borders of Liberty can be finalized.

phases.title: CONTAINMENT
phases.intro: The multi-sector span of the Termicide 2.0-dispersing TCS+ wall is nearing completion, representing approximately half of the full, planned structure. In response, the Terminids are making a concerted to break through and circumvent the new barrier before it seals them in forever. The bugs are applying extreme pressure to our border planets and, if not stopped, may cut off Federal supply lines. The Helldivers are ordered to kill 600,000,000 Terminids, while successfully holding TERREK and ERATA PRIME. Helldivers should anticipate the bugs' unlawful resistance to increase as they grow more desperate to evade their eradication.

phases.title: RAPID RESPONSE
phases.intro: The Automatons have launched an attack on VARYLIA 5 with a sudden and unprovoked kinetic bombardment, inflicting massive devastation across the planet. The strike originated from an orbital weapon platform, briefly seen in the planet’s orbit before disappearing. Automaton forces are now conducting a planetside invasion. The Helldivers must immediately respond. Hold VARYLIA 5 against the Automaton invasion. Additional attacks are anticipated. The Helldivers are ordered to conduct operations on MARFARK, where a Cyborg Megafactory has recently been built, to gather intelligence on which planet will be targeted next.

phases.title: TRIANGULATION
phases.intro: The Automaton orbital platform has struck YED PRIOR. Enemy ground forces have descended to the planet. Helldivers are ordered to deploy to the defense of YED PRIOR. Following the strike, SEAF field decrypters were cut off on WEZEN. Without access to their field expertise, decryption of Automaton transmissions has been stalled. Liberate WEZEN to enable efforts to decrypt enemy communications to continue.

phases.title: FORCEFUL DECOMMISSION
phases.intro:
Intelligence secured from the SEAF decryption forces on WEZEN confirms that Automatons are using X-45 as a hub planet for facilities dedicated to the orbital superweapon. 

X-45 must be liberated in order to seize the data needed to decisively destroy the superweapon. Enemy positions are well-fortified; expect heavy resistance. 

Liberate the planet and secure the intel, to prevent further mass casualties of the Automaton superweapon.

phases.title: WALL EXTENSION
phases.intro:
The TCS+, an interplanetary network of towers that disperse Termicide 2.0, was half-completed thanks to the aid of the Helldivers. The active towers on that planet have worked perfectly, despite a small number of dissident-planted outbreaks.

The time has now come to extend the barrier to fully pen in the Terminid Swarm. TCS+ Towers have been constructed on the following planets: FRONTERIA, TURING, and ACHIRD III. The construction has triggered instinctive assaults from the Terminids. The Helldivers are ordered to defend these planets and activate the TCS+ towers in the process.

phases.title: TRUTH ENFORCEMENT
phases.intro: A recent Cyborg disinformation campaign attempted to spread lies amongst our citizens regarding the efficacy of Termicide 2.0. The Cyborgs have evidently continued investing resources into spreading falsehoods and disunity, likely recognizing they are hopelessly outmatched in conventional warfare. Citizen confidence in government messaging is of paramount importance. The Helldivers are ordered to pause construction of the TCS+ in order to liberate MEISSA, where these duplicitous files were believed to have been fabricated.

phases.title: FINAL CORDON
phases.intro: TCS+ construction has begun on the final Barrier planets. Permanent and total enclosure of the Terminids is within reach. Fierce Terminid assaults are anticipated. The Helldivers must protect the establishment of this intergalactic border. Hold DARIUS II, ACHERNAR SECUNDUS, GRAND ERRANT, and PHERKAD SECUNDUS until the TCS+ is operational.

phases.title: VOID PIERCER
phases.intro: Through their abhorrent manipulation of spacetime, the Illuminate have conjured the Void. To breach this dark anomaly, engineering corps are finalizing a Void Warp Relay on Rirga Bay, designed to insulate fleet hulls against molecular destabilization during FTL transit. However, initial calibration tests have allowed an onslaught of horrific Illuminate creations to spill out from the gateway, threatening to halt the Relay's construction. Helldivers must hold Rirga Bay, stop the spread of these grotesque mutations, and collect critical E-711 to fuel the relay. Securing these reserves is vital to facilitate upcoming SEAF deployments into the unknown.

phases.title: ADVANCEMENT
phases.intro: The Void Warp Relay is online; Helldivers are ordered to enter the Void immediately. Within this anomaly, conventional astronomy and navigational arrays are practically non-functional, owing to the completely alien environment, incomprehensible to standard-issue perception. To enable onward navigation, science teams are deploying alongside ground forces, to analyze target world exposure-duration. Calculating this molecular degradation trail—using an advanced form of cosmic carbon-dating—will lead back to its epicentral origin: the hidden source planet within the Void. To make this process possible, Helldivers must extract 35,000,000 samples from UVP ALPHA, complete 1,000,000 operations on UVP GAMMA, and eliminate 1,250,000,000 hostiles on SENGE 23.

phases.title: DISSOLUTION
phases.intro: The Helldivers have reached the heart of the Void: Seasse. While other worlds suffered only localized ecological damage, this planet has been fundamentally and comprehensively altered into a completely alien ecosystem, extensively occupied by the Illuminate. The planet is a breeding ground for Tyranny that cannot be allowed to spread any further. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate Seasse by any means necessary. While forces clear the surface, an elite 20-person Ministry of Science team will descend into its depths to collapse the Void from within. High Command guarantees this process is entirely safe and completely understood.

phases.title: DISSIDENT MANHUNT
phases.intro: A Terminid outbreak has occurred on BRILLIANCE. The Terminid Control System+ (TCS+) array is under significant distress, with multiple nodes failing. Terminids now threaten to spread across the planet, and break through the TCS+ line. The TCS+ has been empirically proved to make any Terminid infestation impossible. This outbreak, therefore, can only be the result of dissident sabotage. The evidence is clear and undeniable. Despite the dismantling of Automaton disinformation networks, disloyal extremists continue operations to destroy Managed Democracy from within. High Command has ordered an immediate and forceful Counter-Dissidence Crackdown. The Ministry of Truth has identified, with high confidence, three enemy planets as harbors of extremists: GACRUX, GAR HAREN, and LUXURIANT. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate these planets, so the dissidents may be brought to justice.

phases.title: CITIZEN ARREST
phases.intro: The dissident network responsible for the sabotage of the TCS+ has eluded justice. Predictive analytics indicate the network has dispersed domestically, hiding as regular citizens. These dissidents, who exist, must face punishment. High Command has therefore ordered a Full Deputization of Super Earth citizens Class B and above. They have been rapidly trained on traitor identification heuristics, issued printable badges, and granted authority to use necessary force. The Helldivers are ordered to secure material for the production of hunting trophies to reward the capture of suspected dissidents. Neutralize the high-value Illuminate and Cyborg/Automaton belligerents indicated on the Galactic Map in short order.

phases.title: BARRIER ENHANCEMENT
phases.intro: Recent sabotages of the TCS+ by dissidents have threatened the populace and inflamed public outrage. Those responsible sought to spread disunity and doubt, particularly in the security that so many Helldivers sacrificed their lives for. Super Earth will meet these acts of terror with resolve and strength. The TCS+ will not be weakened, but strengthened, as a result of these attacks. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate BORE ROCK and NIVEL 43, Terminid-held planets adjacent to those sabotaged by dissidents, so that the TCS+ can be built on those planets as well. In so doing, the impregnable barrier of the TCS+ will be made twice as impregnable as before.

phases.title: PREEMPTIVE CYBERDEFENCE
phases.intro: The Quarter-Term elections, scheduled to begin in two weeks, may be imperiled. Intercepted Cyborg communications indicate a coordinated, covert plan to impede election Management. Fair and liberated election Management is the bedrock of the Federation, and a citizen-cherished tradition. Ministry of Truth reports indicate the Cyborgs intend to launch a cyberattack with the intent of altering the algorithm that allows citizens to best express their electoral intent. It is believed these assaults will originate from Megafactories on CHARBAL-VII and ZZANIAH PRIME. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate these planets immediately.

phases.title: IMPOSTER MITIGATION
phases.intro: Evidence of an even more abhorrent Cyborg plot to manipulate the upcoming Quarter-term elections has been discovered. Evidence has been obtained indicating enemy efforts to create Automatons with human-like apperances and speech patterns. These androids, disguised as Super Earth citizens, would then attempt to infiltrate voting centers and cast votes. The shocking and vile nature of this plan evidences the extent to which the Cyborg mind has been twisted from their human origins. They cannot be allowed to succeed. The Helldivers are ordered to immediately deploy to destroy 200,000,000 Automaton Troopers, depleting their stock of potential infiltrators.

phases.title: ELECTION RE-FORTIFICATION
phases.intro:
The myriad Cyborg plots to disrupt the Quarter-Term elections have severely damaged citizen confidence in the effective management of their votes. It is imperative that citizens have absolute trust that the results of the election accurately represent their will, as determined by algorithmic inference. 

The Super Earth Government, informed by the results of an expert election security panel, has passed a comprehensive Super Secure Elections Act. By reducing unnecessary oversight and the number of personnel involved in Democratic Management, the process will be far less susceptible to enemy interference. Additionally, the bill allocates new military spending for upholding election security.

Helldiver arsenals have been augmented with a number of stratagems. They are directed to uphold election security—by any means necessary.

phases.title: Secure Territory
phases.intro: The Ministry of Defense has signed a new agreement with AM Defense, the patriotic contractor responsible for the high-quality line of FRVs, to construct a new tank model: the Maelstrom Tank. In an exciting new frontier for civilian freedom, the Tank will be made available for purchase to qualifying citizens. Enemy aggression, however, threatens this Freedom, by denying AM Defense the territory recently allocated for Maelstrom Tank construction. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate MARFARK and PHACT BAY immediately. AM Defense has graciously provided, free of charge, prototype Maelstrom Tank models to augment Helldiver arsenals for the liberation of this territory.

phases.title: Resource Acquisition
phases.intro: Production of Maelstrom Tanks for civilian and military use is proceeding on schedule. Now, deluxe features offered as incentives for early investors must be fabricated. The Helldivers are ordered to dismantle 5,000,000 Automaton Tanks to repurpose their engine cooling systems as climate-controlled cupholders, and harvest 25,000,000 Chargers to convert their carapaces to vibration-insulation panels. AM Defense has invested heavily in tank production, taking on significant debt in the process—a patriotic risk to improve the security of all citizens. Disruption to investor confidence at this critical juncture could jeopardize the project, and AM Defense itself. It is imperative the Helldivers secure these resources.

phases.title: Patriotic Invigoration
phases.intro: Unrelenting enemy aggression threatens to deprive our citizens of their natural-born right to wield heavy armor. AM Defense, aided by the Helldivers, has valiantly fought to provide the Maelstrom Tank to both Helldivers and Federation citizens, but the enemy has inflicted significant costs onto AM Defense, which leveraged extensive debt to finance the project. To recoup these costs, the Helldivers are ordered to aid the creation of a public awareness sales campaign. Footage of the Helldivers obliterating Freedom's enemies will visibly demonstrate the efficacy of the product to consumers. A significant enough increase to pre-sales would provide the funding needed to save the project. GATRIA and WASAT have just come under attack. Deploy to defend these planets, utilizing the Maelstrom Tank.

phases.title: CHEMICAL PEACEKEEPING
phases.intro: Following the Helldivers' victory in collapsing the Void, SEAF Intelligence indicates shattered Illuminate divisions are consolidating ground assets on SENGE 23. High Command has authorized a live broadcast of their imminent eradication to every loyal home to reassure domestic investors and inspire children. To bolster this initative, the recently restored DSS (Democracy Space Station) has deployed, newly equipped with the Eagle Gas Storm to enable widespread chemical peacekeeping. Helldivers are ordered to liberate SENGE 23 and eliminate 400,000,000 Illuminate hostiles to secure the sector.

phases.title: BIO-SAMPLE CULLING
phases.intro: In a show of their depravity, the Illuminate have knowingly altered the harmless gaseous residues dissipating from SENGE 23 into somehow affecting exclusive Class A retirement facilities orbiting the planet. This reckless manipulation of defensive gas strikes—normally entirely benevolent to human lungs—has caused visual obfuscation in residents' private docking bays, minor respiratory irritation, and a sharp rise in unauthorized leave for facility staff. To prove the safety of Eagle Gas Storms, Helldivers must hold SENGE 23, and deploy to the Terminid front to eliminate 30,000,000 Bile Spewers and 40,000,000 Bile Spitters, to aid vital and fully planned research into airborne toxicity.

phases.title: RESTITUTION HARVEST
phases.intro: Following rigorous field validation and formula recalibration, the Ministry of Defense and Ministry of Truth proudly confirm that—for all who hold Liberty dear to their heart—the Eagle Gas Storm is now even safer than it already was, the patented formula demonstrably only targeting alien flesh and treasonous lungs. However, the impact of recent Illuminate interference on Class A elder statespersons cannot go unanswered. High Command has therefore authorised the AIR (Anti-Illuminate Restitution) initiative. For every Illuminate terminated during this order, 0.004 Super Credits will be donated to this vital tax-deductible charitable fund. Helldivers: hold SENGE 23, complete 1,250,000 operations and kill 1,000,000,000 Illuminate forces to restore peace of mind and full respiratory capacity to our most honored retirees.

phases.title: HONOR THE FALLEN
phases.intro: Liberty Day approaches, and with it, the responsibility to honor the memories of fallen heroes. The Super Earth Government has passed a bill authorizing the construction of a memorial worthy of their sacrifices: the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights. As the name implies, the Memorial would honor the fallen not just in thought, but in action: through enhanced interrogation of dissidents and enemies of Freedom. However, wanton aggression from all 3 enemy factions threatens this project. Their occupation of Super Earth territories rich in rare metals, crude oil, and radioactive isotopes, among others, steals from the prosperity of all. This is an insult to the memory of our heroes. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate FURY, ESKER, and ZEA RUGOSIA.

phases.title: INSPIRATIONAL RE-ENACTMENT
phases.intro: The Ministry of Truth is producing an inspirational education film called "Democratic Sniper." Proceeds from the film will go towards construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights, and entitlement payouts for families of fallen soldiers. The film is a dramatic re-enactment of the story of the deadliest Helldiver in the history of the Second Galactic War, with over 4,000 confirmed kills in the course of their 32 minutes of service. It stars Kurt Calhoun, voted 2186's most Democratic bachelor. Much of the film will consist of real battlefield footage. The Helldivers are ordered to kill 300,000,000 Terminids, 65,000,000 Illuminates, and 50,000,000 Automatons to ensure this story is told with the visual spectacle it deserves.

phases.title: INTERROGATION ENHANCEMENT
phases.intro: Enemy aggression has made the construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights impossible. The project has therefore been downscoped to solely consist of the Interrogation Center for Human Rights. As the Automatons were the belligerents who attacked Malevelon Creek, it is only fitting that one of the frontiers of research is digital interrogation: the extraction of information from mechanical and cybernetic combatants. Unpleasant Sensory Experience Simulations have been used to great effect since the start of the Galactic War. To aid development of more effective digital interrogation techniques, the Helldivers are ordered to acquire 35,000,000 Automaton samples and kill 60,000,000 Radicals.

arctic_glacier_base.name: Icy Glaciers
arctic_glacier_base.description: Submerged in eternal winter, this world's frosty peaks glimmer in the light of its too-distant star.

arctic_glacier_coldrocky.name: Boneyard
arctic_glacier_coldrocky.description: Ice and moss-covered rock can be found across most of the surface of this planet.

arctic_glacier_tien_kwan.name: Tien Kwan Special
arctic_glacier_tien_kwan.description: Ice and moss-covered rock can be found across most of the surface of this planet.

blackhole.name: Black Hole
blackhole.description: The planet is gone, the ultimate price to pay in the war for humanity's survival.

bug_hiveworld.name: Hive World
bug_hiveworld.description: This planet has been completely infested by the Terminids, transformed inside and out into a hive of Tyranny.

cyberstan.name: Cyberstan Megafactory
cyberstan.description: Cyberstan, once again, forms the axis of the Cyborg Legion's insurrection. Massive Megafactories cover its surface, churning out mechanical armies and weapons of mass extinction.

deciduous_autumn.name: Autumn Forest
deciduous_autumn.description: Broadleaf woodlands spread across rolling hills, broken by shallow waters that wind through mossy logs, flowers, and stone. (UNOFFICIAL)

deciduous_base.name: Deciduous Forest
deciduous_base.description: Broadleaf woodlands spread across rolling hills, broken by shallow waters that wind through mossy logs, flowers, and stone. (UNOFFICIAL)

deciduous_crimson.name: Crimson Forest
deciduous_crimson.description: Twisted trees bear unearthly white petals which fall like snow upon a sea of cherry-red grass. (Unoffical Description!)

deciduous_fall.name: Autumn Forest
deciduous_fall.description: Broadleaf woodlands spread across rolling hills, broken by shallow waters that wind through mossy logs, flowers, and stone. (Unoffical Description!)

magma_base.name: Magma
magma_base.description: Constant eruptions keep this planet covered in lava flows and utterly inhospitable to Democratic life. It also makes it a treasure trove of rare minerals.

moor_arid.name: Scorched Moor
moor_arid.description: Scorching temperatures, high winds, and low precipitation cause a near-constant cycle of fires to sweep this planet, punctuated by short bursts of lush rebirth between infernos.

moor_baseplanet.name: Plains
moor_baseplanet.description: Rocky outcroppings punctuate fields of tall grass in a planet dominated by misty highland terrain.

moor_red.name: Ionic Crimson
moor_red.description: A crimson algae has propagated wildly across this entire planet, coating its rocky hills with a constant red that masks the spilt blood of the heroes who defend it from tyranny.

moor_tundra.name: Tundra
moor_tundra.description: A perennially chilly climate has allowed short, colorful shrubs to flourish across this planet's surface.

oasis_base.name: Desert Oasis
oasis_base.description: Rolling dunes across a beatiful beach world.  (Unoffical Description!)

oasis_bleak.name: Bleak Oasis
oasis_bleak.description: Dry, windswept dunes trudge on under an eerie halflight, broken only by clusters of struggling palms crouching limply over shallow oases.  (Unoffical Description!)

primordial_base.name: Volcanic Jungle
primordial_base.description: Abundant with life, this wet planet is covered in deep oceans, thick forests, and tall grasses.

primordial_blue.name: Ionic Jungle
primordial_blue.description: The strange subversion of photosynthesis that sustains the oddly-hued flora that flourishes on this planet remains an intriguing mystery to Super Earth's greatest exo-biologists.

primordial_bug.name: Supercolony
primordial_bug.description: Entirely unforeseeable mutations from the Termicide led to hyper-accelerated bug growth on this planet, turning it into a Supercolony. It is corrupted beyond saving. The bugs infest every inch of it, down to the mantle, spawning trillions of spores every day.

primordial_dead.name: Deadlands
primordial_dead.description: The lifeless grey of this planet is interrupted only by the violet flowers that grow from strange, parasitic outcroppings.

primordial_purple.name: Ethereal Jungle
primordial_purple.description: This world teems with ethereal, boundless, and peculiar plant life that spreads silent and uninterrupted across its entire surface.

rift_active.name: Void Forest
rift_active.description: Seasse when horrifically twisted by the void.

sandy_acid.name: Acidic Badlands
sandy_acid.description: Dense, toxic fumes from deep within the planet's crust seep out of cracks in the earth and coat the ground in a sickly haze.

sandy_base.name: Desert Dunes
sandy_base.description: A blazing-hot desert planet, its rocky mesas are the sole interruptions to the endless sea of dunes.

sandy_mineral.name: Rocky Canyons
sandy_mineral.description: This arid, rocky biome covering this world has driven the evolution of exceptionally efficient water usage in its various organisms.

sandy_moon.name: Moon
sandy_moon.description: A rocky, lonely moon with extremely valuable mineral deposits underneath the surface.

sandy_spiky.name: Desert Cliffs
sandy_spiky.description: A desert planet prone to unpredictable and dangerous sand twisters.

super_earth.name: Super Earth
super_earth.description: Super Earth is the blinding beacon that shines the light of democracy through the stars. The sprawling heart that beats in time to mankind's quest of liberation. Here live the wealthy, important and proud. Here live those who have pulled themselves up by their bootstraps and achieved their dreams. Here live the citizens of Super Earth.

swamp_base.name: Basic Swamp
swamp_base.description: Tall, gnarled trees flourish across the surface of this forested world. Sunlight filters past dangling vines, to the saturated undergrowth below.

swamp_haunted.name: Haunted Swamp
swamp_haunted.description: Squelching mud, twisting roots; the odor of rot and anarchy. A teeming, endless morass.

unknown.name: Unknown
unknown.description: This planet's biome is unknown at this time.

acid_storms.description: Corrosive acid storms temporarily reduce armor effectiveness for both enemy and friendly units.
acid_storms.name: Acid Storms

blizzards.description: Intense blizzard reduce mobility and moderately reduce visibility for both enemy and friendly units.
blizzards.name: Blizzards

extreme_cold.description: Icy temperatures reduce rate of fire and delay heat buildup in weapons.
extreme_cold.name: Extreme Cold

fire_tornadoes.description: Planet is ravaged by deadly fire tornadoes.
fire_tornadoes.name: Fire Tornadoes

intense_heat.description: High temperatures increase stamina drain and speed up heat buildup in weapons.
intense_heat.name: Intense Heat

meteor_storms.description: Meteors impact the surface causing massive damage.
meteor_storms.name: Meteor Storms

none.description: This planet's environment is not yet known, or has no environmental modifiers.
none.name: None

normal_temp.description: Average temperatures convey no significant change to weapons or stamina.
normal_temp.name: Normal Temperature

sandstorms.description: Dense sandstorms reduce mobility and greatly reduce visibility for both enemy and friendly units.
sandstorms.name: Sandstorms

thick_fog.description: Dense fog lightly reduce visibility for both enemy and friendly units.
thick_fog.name: Thick Fog

tremors.description: Frequent earthquakes stun players and enemies alike.
tremors.name: Tremors

volcanic_activity.description: Volcanoes throw burning rocks around this planet.
volcanic_activity.name: Volcanic Activity

27836851.name: NEW YEARNING CITY
27836851.description: One of 3 Maximum Security Cities. Impregnable to Tyranny; the future of the Federation.

391918492.name: YORK SUPREME
391918492.description: Following the Great York Conundrum, one City rose above the rest, pledging to hold its Hand over all other Yorks, so that no more blood be spilt between them.

502504685.name: PORT MERCY
502504685.description: Since sheltering millions of loyal refugees in the Last Great War, Port Mercy has been a safe haven for any class-A citizen in need.

550918906.name: EQUALITY-ON-SEA
550918906.description: Named for the historic conference where Humanity was found to be the most Equal species in the Galaxy.

1193052974.name: NEW ASPIRATION CITY
1193052974.description: One of 3 Maximum Security Cities. Impregnable to Tyranny; the future of the Federation.

1199462527.name: REMEMBRANCE
1199462527.description: Risen from the ashes of an ancient city, Rememberance is a monument to the Perseverance of Humankind.

1239520232.name: NEW HOPE CITY
1239520232.description: The flagship Maximum Security City. Impregnable to Tyranny; the future of the Federation.

1475859103.name: URSOOT NINE
1475859103.description: Likely one of the earliest Megafactories to be constructed on Cyberstan. The most significant producer of Cyborg combatants. Defended by the Incineration Corps.

1512842277.name: OMNIPARITUS
1512842277.description: Roughly translates to "Destroy Freedom At All Costs." Significant conventional SEAF assaults will be required to support an offensive here, straining ammunition resources.

1750980320.name: PROSPERITY CITY
1750980320.description: Home to the Democratic Council, our proud Capital is a beacon of Progress, Productivity, and Patriotism.

2340207578.name: AUTONOMY
2340207578.description: High Command has identified this Megafactory as one of two potential beachheads for the invasion of Cyberstan. Rapid insertion protocols will restrict deployment ammunition.

2577020579.name: SOLIDARITET
2577020579.description: High Command has identified this Megafactory as one of two potential beachheads for the invasion of Cyberstan. Anti-air fixtures will hamper Pelican extraction.

2634960640.name: LURZA
2634960640.description:
Monuments in this Megafactory twist history to valorize the supposed resolve of Cyborgs to "endure" Super Earth's benevolent attempts to rehabilitate them. 

Anti-air defenses will hinder Eagle operations.

2735744233.name: STAR KIELD
2735744233.description: Roughly translates to "All Humans Must Die." One of the largest Megafactories on Cyberstan. A critical military production node. Defended by the Jet Brigade.

3380242454.name: TRANSCENDENCE
3380242454.description: The first and most well-defended Megafactory. The nexus of Cyborg command. Its destruction will trigger the collapse of the enemy's defenses on Cyberstan. Expect extreme resistance.

3404329179.name: CAMRAT FOR
3404329179.description: This Megafactory contains significant Automaton production facilities. Anti-orbital defenses will tax Super Destroyer resources, resulting in longer orbital cooldowns.

3958784315.name: ADMINISTRATIVE CENTER 02
3958784315.description: Each form and application that passes through the hallowed halls of AdminCen is emblazoned with the Stamp of Ages, and should be given a place of honor in the home.

4196558004.name: EAGLEOPOLIS
4196558004.description: This Great Heart of Commerce is renowned galaxy-wide for its Grand Shopping Malls and Splendorous Entertainment Centers.

so.msg: STRATEGIC OPPORTUNITY SEIZED Helldivers have contained the outbreak on Nivel 43, securing essential footage for Democratic Sniper. Simultaneously, reports of new Terminid mutations have been investigated; the mutations were determined to be merely superficial changes, well within normal Terminid gene expression. The Ministry of Truth has deemed the filmed footage to be of masterfully evocative cinematic quality. As a result, the remaining major order requirements are reduced by 50%.

NEW STRATEGIC OPPORTUNITY A Terminid outbreak has occurred on Nivel 43, likely due to the splintered remnants of the eco-fascistic terrorist network culled in the Counterdissident Hammer campaign. While the threat is assessed as very low, it presents an opportunity to capture vital footage of their wanton aggression. Helldivers must aid in this virtuously expedient cause and liberate Nivel 43. Securing the footage will reduce remaining major order requirement by 50%.

3291378705.brief: Acquire Automaton samples and kill Cyborgs to aid the development of enhanced digital interrogation techniques.
